steps.eval: (()=>{const g=__rhf.game; g.state.settings.autoQuality=false; g.setQuality('medium'); g.dpr=1; g.renderer.setPixelRatio(1); g.resize(); g.bears.directorT=9999; const we=g.env.weather; we.cloud=0.2; we.cloudTarget=0.2; we.rain=0; we.rainTarget=0; we.timer=9999; g.hud.firstShown=-1000; g.hud.hint('',0); __rhf.god(true); g.env.setTime(10.5); g.env.timeScale=0; g.wildlife.threatPos=()=>({x:1e7,z:1e7,loud:0}); window.__until=async(fn,ms=90000)=>{const t0=performance.now(); while(performance.now()-t0<ms){ const r=fn(); if(r) return r; await new Promise(q=>setTimeout(q,200)); } return null;}; return 'ok'})()

(async()=>{const g=__rhf.game; const W=g.world; const cs=g.wildlife.animals.filter(a=>a.species==='caribou'&&!a.dead); const a=cs[0]; let best=null; for(let k=0;k<600;k++){ const ang=Math.random()*6.283, r=Math.random()*150; const x=a.x+Math.cos(ang)*r, z=a.z+Math.sin(ang)*r; if(!W.inBounds(x,z,30)||W.waterAt(x,z)||W.slopeAt(x,z)>0.12) continue; const x2=x+22; if(W.waterAt(x2,z)||W.slopeAt(x2,z)>0.12||Math.abs(W.heightAt(x2,z)-W.heightAt(x,z))>1||g.colliders.circlesNear(x+11,z,12).length) continue; best={x,z}; break; } if(!best) return 'no flat spot'; for(const o of cs) if(o!==a){ o.x+=200; o.z+=200; } a.x=best.x+22; a.z=best.z; a.yaw=0; a.state='idle'; a.t=9999; a.speed=0; a.cfg.flee=0; window.__target=a; g.player.place(best.x,best.z,0); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,800)); return 'caribou at '+Math.hypot(a.x-g.player.pos.x,a.z-g.player.pos.z).toFixed(1)+' m, arrows '+g.state.gear.arrows})()

(async()=>{const g=__rhf.game; const r=await __until(()=>g.player.tool==='bow'&&g.viewmodel.shown==='bow'&&g.viewmodel.switchT>=1); return 'tool '+g.player.tool+' shown '+g.viewmodel.shown+', primary '+document.getElementById('btn-primary').textContent+', arrows chip '+document.getElementById('hud-arrows').textContent+(r?'':' (timed out)')})()

(()=>{const g=__rhf.game; const a=__target; const P=g.player.pos; const ty=g.world.heightAt(a.x,a.z)+a.cfg.height*0.72*a.scale; const d=Math.hypot(a.x-P.x,a.z-P.z); g.player.yaw=Math.atan2(-(a.x-P.x),-(a.z-P.z)); g.player.pitch=Math.atan2(ty-(P.y+1.7),d)+0.024; return 'aimed'})()
(async()=>{const H=__rhf.game.hunting; const r=await __until(()=>H.draw>=1); return 'full draw '+(!!r)+', label '+document.getElementById('btn-primary').textContent})()

(async()=>{const g=__rhf.game; const H=g.hunting; await __until(()=>!H.drawing); const r=await __until(()=>H.arrows.length===0||H.arrows.every(x=>x.stuck)); const a=__target; const w=H.arrows[0]; const P=g.player.pos; return 'arrows left '+g.state.gear.arrows+', in the world '+H.arrows.length+(w?(', landed in '+w.landed+' at '+Math.hypot(w.pos.x-P.x,w.pos.z-P.z).toFixed(1)+' m'):'')+(H.lastHit?(', hit '+H.lastHit.species+' '+H.lastHit.zone):'')+' | caribou hp '+Math.round(a.hp)+' dead '+a.dead})()

(async()=>{const g=__rhf.game; const H=g.hunting; const a=__target; a.x+=300; const P=g.player.pos; const yaw=g.player.yaw; const fx=-Math.sin(yaw), fz=-Math.cos(yaw); H.spawn(new (P.constructor)(P.x+fx*0.5,P.y+1.6,P.z+fz*0.5), new (P.constructor)(fx*14,3,fz*14), 100); const r=await __until(()=>H.arrows.some(x=>x.stuck&&!x.inWater)); if(!r) return 'test arrow never landed'; const s=H.arrows.find(x=>x.stuck&&!x.inWater); const before=g.state.gear.arrows; g.player.place(s.pos.x+0.4,s.pos.z,g.player.yaw); await __until(()=>g.state.gear.arrows>before, 20000); return 'picked up: quiver '+before+' -> '+g.state.gear.arrows})()

(async()=>{const g=__rhf.game; await __until(()=>g.player.tool==='none'&&g.viewmodel.switchT>=1); return 'tool '+g.player.tool+', primary hidden '+document.getElementById('btn-primary').hidden+', tool icon '+document.querySelector('#btn-tool use').getAttribute('href')})()
